title: Identification.
officialText:
Identification of structural steel members shall comply with the requirements contained in AISC 360.
Identification of cold-formed steel members shall comply with the requirements contained in AISI S100. Identification of cold-
formed steel light-frame construction shall also comply with the requirements contained in AISI S200. Other steel furnished for
structural load carrying purposes shall be properly identified for conformity to the ordered grade in accordance with the specified
ASTM standard or other specification and the provisions of this chapter. Steel that is not readily identifiable as to grade from
marking and test records shall be tested to determine conformity to such standards.
